verdict.rationale: Bruno ships its own AI features (chat sidebar, script and test generation, BYOK and OpenAI-compatible providers), so asking whether it can act as an MCP client is fair. Nothing in the evidence shows Bruno connecting to or using external MCP servers' tools. The Cursor, VS Code and Codex integrations describe external agents working with Bruno collections, which is a different direction and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
